name: BURN_NFT
description: Permanently burn an NFT by serial number from the treasury account. This is irreversible. The collection must have a supply key. The NFT must be owned by the treasury.

implicitBehaviors.behavior: Serial number is wrapped in an array for setSerials()
implicitBehaviors.details: The SDK's setSerials() expects an array of Long values, but the input is a single serial number. The handler wraps it as [input.serial].

implicitBehaviors.behavior: Supply key signing via freeze + sign pattern
implicitBehaviors.details: If supplyPrivateKey is provided, the transaction is frozen with freezeWith() then signed with the supply key. Otherwise operator key signs automatically.

inputs.name: serial
inputs.describe: The serial number of the NFT to burn

inputs.name: supplyPrivateKey
inputs.describe: Supply key (only if different from operator key)

successData.name: serial
successData.describe: The serial number of the burned NFT

errorMap.details: This collection has no supply key. Burning is permanently disabled.
Transaction signature is invalid. The supply key doesn't match.
The token ID does not exist on this network.
The specified NFT serial does not exist in this collection.
The treasury does not own this NFT serial. Only treasury-held NFTs can be burned.
Not enough HBAR to cover the transaction fee.
